summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 of the cipher-box project — E2E test expansion (account cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests) and staging baselines (journey timing, load tests, BYO-IPFS capacity testing with Pinata).
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (13/13 must-haves passed). Real staging baselines captured: journey timing (login 22.9s, upload 906ms, share 1.5s), 200-client SDK sustained load (11,174 ops, 0.17% error rate), and BYO capacity ceiling (Pinata free tier exhausted during test). Browser load test removed as redundant. PR #392 created with load test GH Actions workflow updated to support BYO scenarios.

repo: Staging Web3Auth SDK initialization takes ~22.7s — wallet button timeout in E2E specs must be at least 30-45s when targeting staging (not the default 20s used for localhost).
playwright.config.ts did not respect BASE_URL env var for staging runs — required explicit env var handling and webServer conditional skip.
Running two SDK load tests simultaneously against the same staging instance causes apparent throttle bypass failures — tests must run sequentially against staging.
The bypass header mechanism works correctly (confirmed via curl, Node, and vitest) — concurrent test collisions were the root cause of 429s, not a code bug.
Pinata free tier has storage/pin limits that get exhausted quickly under load test scenarios — paid plan or fresh account required for BYO capacity ceiling tests.
BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging even when Pinata pin succeeds — test accounts may not be configured with BYO mode or endpoint expects different params.
SDK load tests use destroyClientPool() → deleteTestAccount() (direct API, no browser). Browser E2E tests use deleteAccountViaPage() (page.evaluate fetch). These are completely separate paths.
cleanup-helpers.ts deleteAccountViaPage derives API URL from page URL hostname — uses api- prefix convention (app-staging.cipherbox.cc → api-staging.cipherbox.cc).
The browser-based load-test.spec.ts was removed as redundant — SDK harness provides strictly better data (more clients, real API metrics, no browser overhead confounding results).
load-test.yml GH Actions workflow needed BYO scenario options and BYO_* env var inputs added to support Pinata-backed load testing from CI.

code.finding: deleteAccountViaPage merges two page.evaluate calls into one to eliminate extra browser round-trip. API URL derived from page URL hostname.
BASE_URL env var now respected for staging runs; webServer block conditionally skipped when BASE_URL is set to avoid trying to start localhost server.
Wallet button waitFor timeout increased from 20s to 45s to accommodate Web3Auth init delay on staging (~22.7s).
Vitest does not load .env files by default — env vars must be sourced via shell before running (source .env && npx vitest).
fs/path imports moved to top-level; existsSync + unlinkSync TOCTOU replaced with try/catch; corrupt file test wrapped in try/finally for guaranteed cleanup.
All byo-pin ops failed with Pinata free tier plan limits exceeded — baseline documents failure pattern, not throughput.

workflow: Cherry-picking from worktree branches to main phase branch requires stashing local uncommitted changes first to avoid conflicts on STATE.md.
classifyHandoffIfNeeded is a known Claude Code runtime bug — if agent reports failed with this error but SUMMARY.md exists and commits are present, treat as successful.
Running load tests in parallel against the same staging instance creates apparent throttle failures even with bypass headers — always run sequentially.
GSD insert-phase should only be used for work that falls between phases — gap closure within the current phase uses plan-phase --gaps instead.
Pinata JWT (BYO_IPFS_AUTH_TOKEN) must be populated directly in tests/load/.env — the file is gitignored and not set up by default.

friction: Cherry-picking worktree commits to phase branch required multiple stash/unstash cycles due to STATE.md conflicts from parallel agents both writing to it.
BASE_URL env var not respected by playwright.config.ts — caused first staging run to silently target localhost, wasting a test run.
20s wallet button timeout insufficient for staging Web3Auth init — caused misleading timeout failure before root cause (blank page) was identified.
Simultaneously running BYO ceiling and sustained load tests caused both to fail with 429s, requiring re-investigation that ultimately found no code bug.
Vitest does not load .env files automatically — required shell-level env sourcing workaround rather than a proper vitest config fix.
Pinata free tier exhausted during BYO capacity ceiling test runs — all pin ops failed, preventing meaningful BYO throughput baselines.
1Password SSH signing failures intermittently blocked git commits, requiring retry.
SSH attempts to inspect Docker container env vars on staging VPS timed out.
open_items: BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging — debug whether test accounts need BYO mode configuration or endpoint params differ (tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-debug-byo-ipfs-register-cid-400-errors-on-staging.md).
Pinata paid plan or fresh free account needed to get successful BYO capacity ceiling baseline — current baseline only documents failure behavior.
New E2E specs (streaming-playback, media-preview, batch-download) use binary stub fixtures — need live environment run to confirm stubs trigger correct AES-CTR/GCM code paths.

SDK test harness createTestAccount does not pass throttle bypass header during initial account creation batching — worth verifying this path is correct under high concurrency (though confirmed working with 200 clients solo).
Phase 34 HUMAN-UAT items (media fixture AES-CTR/GCM validation) persist with status: partial — will surface in /gsd:progress until verified.
